newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia still scrutinising De Beers deal - official.
newsitem.headline: Russia still scrutinising De Beers deal - official.

text.p: A senior Russian precious metals and stones official said on Tuesday that a long-delayed diamond deal between Russia and De Beers was undergoing further government reviews and could be delayed indefinitely.

Vladimir Piskunov, head of the Industry Ministry's precious metals and stones section, told a news conference that the Russian government was examining the text of the agreement "at the highest levels" and said it had requested further evaluation of the document.
